note_text:
CC: follow up plantar fasciitis

HPI: weeks of symptoms relating to painful plantar callus. PMH: Type 2 diabetes mellitus. Sensory neuropathy noted on prior visits.

Exam: plantar callus area consistent with painful plantar callus; general inspection of the foot otherwise unremarkable.

MDM: discussed risks and benefits of the planned procedure; patient consents. Mentioned other complaints, no separate management plan.

Procedure: Paring of single hyperkeratotic lesion performed (LT and RT modifiers documented). Tolerated well, no immediate complications.
